substantiveFindings: Owner pass over the complete chapter: all 261 Chinese units with both English fields, all 4 people, 18 mention rows, 56 claims, 242 preflight candidates (236 dispositioned; the remaining 6 are consumed by the person mentions), the date audit (12 date items, 4 findings) and the 5 accepted editorial repairs.

No missing person or mention. The treatise is technical calendar procedure; the only individuated persons are the four named in s0224-s0226. The edicts in s0223, s0224 and s0226 (詔, 命) are impersonal court commands with no ruler surface to capture.

Chronology: the audit blocked 「七年」 because no unit names its era. The same Chongtian treatise supplies the witness. Songshi 071 s0287-s0288 says the calendar was completed in Tiansheng 1, eighth month (至天聖元年八月成…命曰《崇天曆》), and s0289 identifies Tiansheng 2 as a jiazi year (距天聖二年甲子). This chapter's s0222 says the finished calendar was used from the following jiazi year, whose fifth-month new moon fell on a dinghai day (以來年甲子歲用之，是年五月丁亥朔). 「至七年」 in s0224 therefore continues the Tiansheng era: Tiansheng 7 = AD 1029, the extraction's existing value. Independent astronomical check: the mean new moon of June 1024 (JD 2095234.0) falls on a dinghai day, while the other Song jiazi years (964, 1084) have no dinghai fifth-month new moon.

Definite English errors in 10 technical units (17 field edits): s0032 九百九 (909) rendered as 999 in both fields (909/68 = 13.3676 du per day agrees with 交終度 363.76 / 交終日 27.2122); operand reversals of 以平合初日行分減一百分 in s0199 and s0243 (both fields); the 以距合差日減盈縮分 literal wording in s0206, identical to accepted repair r0003 at s0250; the 覆減一百分 reversal in s0211 idiomatic, identical to accepted repair r0004 at s0256; 前段末日行分 rendered as 'this segment's / its last-day motion' in s0176 and s0235 (both fields); 因 rendered as 'multiply' in the s0174 and s0176 literal fields, against the parallel s0233; and 以一百約…減之 rendered as 'subtract one hundred of' in s0255 and s0260 (both fields), where 約 is division as in every 'hundred-reduce' in the chapter.

Noted, not proposed: 日辰 after 命甲子，算外 (s0150, s0213, s0253, s0258) is rendered 'day and time' / 'day and double-hour'. The computation names a day from jiazi, so 'the day's sexagenary designation' may be more exact, but this is not definite enough to count as a source error.
Identity: no false merge; the four calendar officials are distinct, and Zhou Cong's canonical dossier spans songshi 073/074/076 without date conflict.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 以九百九乘之，六十八除為度，不盡，退除為分，即朔、望加時月入陰陽曆積度及分。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Multiply by 999, divide by 68 for degrees; what does not exhaust, retreat-divide for parts — that is the month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition moon's entry into yin-yang calendar accumulated degrees and parts.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Multiply by 909, divide by 68 for degrees; what does not exhaust, retreat-divide for parts — that is the month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition moon's entry into yin-yang calendar accumulated degrees and parts.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 九百九 is 909 (cf. 一百五 = 105), not 999. 909/68 = 13.3676 du per day, which equals the chapter's own 交終度 363.76 divided by 交終日 27.2122, the moon's daily motion relative to the node; 999/68 would be 14.69.

citation.excerpt: 以九百九乘之，六十八除為度

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 以九百九乘之，六十八除為度，不盡，退除為分，即朔、望加時月入陰陽曆積度及分。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Multiply by 999, divide by 68 for degrees, reduce any remainder to parts, and obtain syzygy hour accumulated solar-path or lunar-path degrees and parts.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Multiply by 909, divide by 68 for degrees, reduce any remainder to parts, and obtain syzygy hour accumulated solar-path or lunar-path degrees and parts.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: Same numeral as the literal field: 九百九 = 909.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 若前段無平行分相減為泛差者，各因後段初日行分與其段平行分相減，為半總差；
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: If the prior segment has no parallel motion from which to subtract for a generalized difference, for each multiply the subsequent segment's first-day motion parts minus this segment's parallel motion — that is the half total difference;
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: If the prior segment has no parallel motion from which to subtract for a generalized difference, for each subtract this segment's parallel motion from the subsequent segment's first-day motion parts — that is the half total difference;
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 各因…與其段平行分相減 takes the two values and subtracts them; 因 here is 'take', not 'multiply'. The literal field's 'multiply … minus' contradicts the idiomatic field and the parallel literal at s0233.

citation.excerpt: 各因後段初日行分與其段平行分相減

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 若後段無平行分相減為泛差者，各因前段末日行分與其段平行分相減，為半總差。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: If the subsequent segment has no parallel motion from which to subtract for a generalized difference, for each multiply this segment's last-day motion parts minus this segment's parallel motion — that is the half total difference.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: If the subsequent segment has no parallel motion from which to subtract for a generalized difference, for each subtract this segment's parallel motion from the prior segment's last-day motion parts — that is the half total difference.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 前段末日行分 is the prior segment's last-day motion, which must be used because the subsequent segment lacks a parallel motion. The literal field gives 'this segment's last-day motion parts' and also misreads 因 as 'multiply'.

definiteTranslationRepairs.after: If the subsequent segment lacks a parallel motion for subtraction, subtract this segment's parallel motion from the prior segment's last-day motion parts for each case; the result is the half total difference.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 求五星定合日定星：以其星平合初日行分減一百分，餘以約其日太陽盈縮分為分，分滿百為日，不滿為分，命為距合差日；
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction day and fixed star: subtract one hundred parts from that star's mean-conjunction first-day motion parts; with the remainder reduce that day's solar excess-deficit parts for parts; when parts fill one hundred that makes days, what does not fill is parts — name as distance-from-conjunction difference day;
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction day and fixed star: subtract that star's mean-conjunction first-day motion parts from one hundred parts; with the remainder reduce that day's solar excess-deficit parts for parts; when parts fill one hundred that makes days, what does not fill is parts — name as distance-from-conjunction difference day;
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 以A減B is B − A (accepted repair songshi:073:r0003 at s0250). 以其星平合初日行分減一百分 is 100 − first-day motion. Physically this is the outer-planet case, where first-day motion is below the sun's 100 parts; s0202 gives the reversed inner-planet form 以一百分減初日行分 separately.

evidence.quote: 曆既成，以來年甲子歲用之，是年五月丁亥朔，日食不效，算食二分半，候之不食。
至七年，命入內都知江德明集曆官用渾儀較測。
既上奏，詔翰林學士晏殊制序而施行焉，命曰《崇天曆》。
曆法曰演紀上元甲子，距天聖二年甲子
